server.name: supplymind-webmcp
server.description: SupplyMind does NOT expose a remote MCP server. There is no /mcp HTTP endpoint or SSE/stdio transport. Capabilities are instead exposed as client-side WebMCP tools (navigator.modelContext / ModelContext.registerTool) registered by the frontend module src/lib/webmcp.ts. This card documents those tools for agents that discover MCP-style metadata; agents that understand WebMCP should read .well-known/agent-card.json. All tools authenticate with a SupplyMind bearer token (see https://supplymind.tech/.well-known/auth.md).
server.instructions: Read https://supplymind.tech/.well-known/auth.md first to obtain a token, then call tools with an Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Tools are only available while the SupplyMind SPA is open in a WebMCP-capable browser; there is no standalone endpoint.

transport.note: No remote MCP transport exists. WebMCP tools are injected client-side by the SPA and do not require an outbound connection.

tools.name: rag-query
tools.description: Answer a question grounded in the SupplyMind knowledge base (products, forecasting, platform operations). Returns the answer with cited sources.

product_id.description: Optional product SKU to scope the query

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Generate a demand forecast for a product SKU over a horizon in days. Returns monthly summary and forecast points.

tools.name: inventory-optimization
tools.description: Fetch inventory optimization recommendations: reorder points, safety stock, ABC/XYZ classification. Optional limit.

tools.name: executive-insights
tools.description: Generate AI executive insights for a product SKU: executive summary, insights with impact/confidence, and recommendations.
